title: Caught in a sticky predicament
explanation: The source explains the expression as getting into severe difficulty. The image conveys being caught and unable to move freely.
meaning_odia: ଭୀଷଣ ଅସୁବିଧାରେ ପଡ଼ି ଉପାୟ ନ ପାଇବାକୁ ଏହି ରୂଢ଼ି ବୁଝାଏ।
